'''Sedition''' was a division of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. It specialized in knowledge and predictions on organized resistance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. As resentment to the Empire grew during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], so did the size of Sedition.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
